display_name: 导师补实验：优化自适应 Tri 与普通 PL
description: 三档总标签预算、16 个等量源接收机组合、四折留日和向前测试。24 个设置逐一配对。
authorization: 2026-11-24 用户要求跑 Word 导师提出的补实验

code.commit: Git commit stored in dispatch runtime
code.checkout: Advisor transfer plus frozen runtime e479c466a6a0b1862a17407f6ad5f4d2ec6aedd2

data.version: 20261023 retained eq1 role and fixed IQ caches
data.leo_config_ref: Locked seven Phase1 practical-residual views in the October paper context

permissions.claim_scope: Phase1 closed-set frozen DG on terrestrial IQ with simulated practical impairments

checkpoint.initialization: Scratch E20 or verified same-contract E20; inherit an exact existing final PL or no-trigger Tri fallback only
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Same cache, seed, scratch ancestry, source-only E20/E50 required
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final E50; V only for source monitoring; no target feedback

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0–7, one new-run worker per card, 11000 MiB free per launch, one CPU scorer
execution.stop_rule: Stop new dispatch on first technical failure, retain all existing artifacts and healthy own workers

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent truth-last Phase1 scoring, same clean and six practical views

notes: Nov 21 approved setting profiles with E20 low-coverage correction. No target metrics select a profile.
E20 correction triggers at source-label median <14, using 0.55+0.15*n/(n+14) with upper bound .99.

Budget3150 uses fusion RX balancing. One source uses Hybrid. Six sources use raw KL and same-day fusion; coverage=10 additionally triggers E20. This combination is a new transfer of the published rule.
Same fixed seed, 24 adaptive and 24 ordinary PL. 25 new trajectories, 23 exact final reuses. Existing processes stay active.
